walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Volute VC
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to track your cognitive process alongside your code

steps.title: Welcome to Volute VC
steps.description:
Volute VC augments Git by tracking the 'why' alongside the 'what'. Your AI conversations, reasoning, and context are preserved and linked to your commits.

[Learn More](https://volutevc.com/docs)

media.markdown:
# Git, Augmented

Volute creates a **Shadow DAG** - a parallel history of reasoning that accompanies your code changes.

steps.title: Use the @volute Chat Participant
steps.description:
Type `@volute` in the GitHub Copilot Chat to automatically log your AI conversations.

[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

media.markdown:
## The Native Delegate

The `@volute` participant intercepts your prompts, delegates to your existing LLM, and logs everything to the cognitive timeline.

steps.title: View Your Cognitive Timeline
steps.description:
Open the Volute panel in the Activity Bar to see your pending thoughts and historical context.

[Open Timeline](command:volute.timeline.focus)

media.markdown:
## Pending Thoughts

See your floating thoughts before committing. They'll be automatically linked to your next `git commit`.

steps.title: Commit Your Code
steps.description: When you run `git commit`, all pending thoughts are automatically linked to that commit. The 'why' is now permanently bound to the 'what'.

media.markdown:
## Late Binding

Volute uses an **Immediate Persistence, Late Binding** model. Thoughts are saved immediately, but linked to commits only when you commit.
